# Espresso

Dialling in espresso on the lever machine I carried home from [[Lisbon]]. Start with 18 g of finely ground coffee and aim for 36 g in the cup in about 28 seconds. Grind finer when the shot runs fast and tastes sour, coarser when it drips slowly and tastes bitter.

## Milk

Steam whole milk to about 60 °C with the wand tip just under the surface, then sink it to spin the jug until the foam is glossy enough to pour a heart.
